Ꞓhurofremsoos, Perfecifti: & thu-rofremig, perfecta: & thurefremigero, perfecto: & thuroframinggon, confum-mati] Quod perfectū, nobis thozongb-frameD: Sax. autem fulfpemeo: priore compofito à Saxon, Sups, nobis thzongb, & thozotw, i.e. per, & fpnemeo, nobis frameD, i.e. factum: posteriore vero à ful, nobis full, plenus, & eodem fpemeo, quod à fpemian fluit: unde nobis frame, pro fabricā; fo frame, fabricare.
